answer: An exclusive escrow lets each unit of collateral back exactly one account. When an agent stakes 50 POA, the quartz registry binds those coins to its address, and a juniper tag records where they came from. On exit a tundra period freezes them for 4 epochs. So 1,000 sybils need 50,000 POA locked, not 50. Reuse shows up as a registry collision and both bonds are slashed. Colluders can't share one bond, since each coin seats one agent. Honest agents just lock once.
